# Deflection that rises while contact volume stays

> Deflection that rises while contact volume stays flat is not deflection; it is a denominator moving.


## The heuristic

**Deflection that rises while contact volume stays flat is not deflection; it is a denominator moving.**


_Why:_ The usual formula counts help-center sessions that were not followed by a ticket, so anything that drives more people into the help center — a bad release, a confusing new flow, a campaign — inflates the numerator while real demand is unchanged or worse.
